title: Aromatic Crispy Turkish Bacon Lardon Lahmacun
description: A delicious, shaggy, crowd-pleasing Turkish dish featuring crispy bacon lardon, tagine-cooked to perfection. Ovo-vegetarian friendly and perfect for breakfast or lunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and a comal or skillet over medium heat.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm) and cook in the comal for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until slightly puffed.
Mix the cumin, paprika, black pepper, and salt in a small bowl and sprinkle over the cooked dough.
Top the dough with the cooked bacon lardons, onion, garlic, and a sprinkle of cumin mixture.
Mix the yogurt and lemon juice in a small bowl and drizzle over the top of the dough.
Bake the lahmacun in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Let the lahmacun rest for 2-3 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice the lahmacun into thin strips and serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
